title: personal-kpi-weekly-checkin-leo-hartman-2026-04-19
content:
Weekly check-in / scratchpad - Leo Hartman (platform engineer)

Date: 2026-04-19
Context: quick personal check-in focused on Q2 goals (inference platform performance & reliability), items to action this week, and blockers. This is informal — notes to self, planning, and TODOs.

Top-line objectives (Q2 draft):
- O1: Reduce p99 tail latency for hosted-chat endpoints from 360ms -> 320ms (target -11%). Measure by per-route dashboard (console).
  - KR1: Tune batching + KV cache heuristics to reduce net token compute by 8% for chat workloads.
  - KR2: Ship 2 kernel-level micro-optimizations for attention path (Llama-style models) with regression tests.
  - KR3: Keep error budget >99.95% for the quarter.
- O2: Lower inference unit costs for mid-sized customers by 12% via smarter routing + quantization profiles.
  - KR1: Add per-customer routing policy for cost-preferring fallback models.
  - KR2: Land 3 new quantization profiles in Redwood Optimize.
- O3: Personal growth: mentoring (2x mentee check-ins / month), own one postmortem and lead a rotation.

This week's focus (Sprint week):
- Finish perf experiment for batched KV cache threshold (A/B variant): collect metrics by EOD Thu.
- Prototype attention-kernel patch (micro-opt 1) and open draft PR. Need to run unit/integration on dedicated infra.
- Draft docs for per-customer routing policy (rough one-pager for product review).
- Mentor: schedule 1:1 with mentee (Avery) and prepare career checkpoint notes.

Metrics snapshot to track (notes):
- P50/P95/P99 for chat-gen routes (daily): 85ms / 120ms / 360ms (baseline 2026-04-12).
- Median tokens/sec for dedicated pools: 12k t/s.
- Cost per 1k tokens (hosted): $0.42 (goal: $0.37).
- Error rate (HTTP 5xx + inference failures): 0.03%

Open items / blockers:
- Need access to perf cluster v3 for kernel CI (infra ticket JIRA-PLAT-378 stalled) — ping infra, escalate if no response by Wed.
- Quant profiles awaiting model validation from applied-ml (PR#512).
- Ambiguity on routing policy UI fields — sync with product (Maya) to finalize required knobs.

Decisions to make this week:
- If batched KV cache experiment reduces token compute by <4%, revert change and investigate alternate batch scheduling.
- Prioritize micro-opt 1 (attention) over micro-opt 2 if CI time is >24h — need to keep iteration short.

Action items (TODOs):
- [ ] Run full experiment sweep and upload results to confluence (due Thu). Linked artifacts: CONFLUENCE-4821.
- [ ] Draft routing policy one-pager for product review (due Fri).
- [ ] Create PR for kernel patch and add perf benchmarks (draft by Wed).
- [ ] 1:1 with Avery (mentor) — prep agenda: goals, blockers, career ladder.
- [ ] Follow up with infra on JIRA-PLAT-378 (request staged environment access).

Retro notes (quick):
- Last sprint: batching heuristic change improved throughput but introduced rare timeout at high concurrency — root cause appears to be lock contention in queue manager. Plan: add metrics and tracing to queue manager (low effort).
- Positive: on-call handoff doc was helpful; reduced wake-ups by clarifying runbook for cold-starts.

Free-form ideas / friction log:
- Could we experiment with a light-weight model variant that strips non-critical layers for cost-sensitive routing? Might be useful for mid-market customers.
- Need clearer signal in console for "cost vs latency" tradeoff at route-level (show predicted cost delta for policy changes).
- Thought: set up monthly "perf day" to pair with applied-ml for end-to-end validation of quant profiles.

Notes to self:
- Keep PRs small. Focus on quick wins for Q2 to show progress on O1.
- Do not bury perf regressions behind feature flags — prefer canary + rollbacks.

References / links (scratch):
- Confluence draft: CONFLUENCE-4821 (perf experiment results)
- Infra ticket: JIRA-PLAT-378 (cluster v3 access)
- Repo PR: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/512 (quant profiles)

End of check-in.
summary: Weekly personal check-in: Q2 OKR draft focused on reducing p99 latency, lowering inference cost, and personal mentoring; tasks: perf experiments, kernel patch PR, routing policy doc; blockers: infra access and model validation.
